verdict: Organic visibility is softening; paid channels remain offline this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, generating 39 total actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — from 303 impressions. That activity has slowed sharply, with GBP actions down 55% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days prior, likely reflecting reduced local search visibility or normal seasonal softening. Paid advertising on Meta and Google ran no spend this period, so there is no paid pipeline currently supporting lead flow. Conversion tracking on the website is also being reviewed, as 179 site sessions produced zero recorded conversions — a result that points to a tracking gap rather than zero genuine interest. Restoring paid activity is the immediate priority to rebuild a consistent lead pipeline.
